source_definition: Coordinate onboarding of a prospective trading counterparty by collecting required legal-entity, tax, settlement, and commercial documentation; initiating and recording required compliance, sanctions/KYC, legal, and credit clearances through their accountable owners; and creating the authorized counterparty and settlement records once required approvals are complete.
target_definition: Assess a counterparty's creditworthiness — at onboarding, on a periodic cycle, and on trigger events — analyzing financial statements, ratings, ownership and support structures, payment behavior, and qualitative factors, and assigning or updating the internal credit assessment that limits and monitoring run on.
pipeline_rationale: prerequisite condition: credit review must complete before counterparty creation
reviewer_notes: Genuine prerequisite gate: credit review must complete before a new counterparty can be created. Recommend approve KEEP core:requires.
Hamid_rationale: Genuine precondition: credit clearance must precede creation of the authorized counterparty and settlement records. Stored as core:requires. Hamid 2026-09-25.

source_definition: Coordinate the administrative counterparty offboarding or transfer — confirming that affected positions, agreements, collateral, payment instructions, and reporting responsibilities have been closed, settled, transferred, or queued for legally effective novation — and deactivate or transition counterparty records with preserved history.
target_definition: Administer contractual credit support both held and posted — cash collateral, securities, letters of credit, guarantees, and other eligible security, with their haircuts, thresholds, independent amounts, and substitutions — calling, receiving, returning, valuing, and reconciling credit support under the applicable arrangements, so credit exposure is secured to the extent the agreements require.
pipeline_rationale: prerequisite condition: collateral position settled before termination/novation
reviewer_notes: Genuine prerequisite: offboarding/transfer requires collateral positions to be administered and confirmed. Recommend approve KEEP core:requires.
Hamid_rationale: Valid closure-control prerequisite: collateral and related obligations must be closed, settled, transferred, or queued before the counterparty record is deactivated or transitioned. Stored as core:requires. Hamid 2026-09-25.

source_definition: Record executed structured and non-standard transactions — multi-leg, embedded-optionality, tolling, prepay, and similar bespoke deals — decomposing them into capturable components so their positions, risks, and obligations are fully represented rather than approximated.
target_definition: Produce and control the official valuations of the trading book — marking positions to market or, where approved, to model per approved methodology from the official curves and parameters, applying approved valuation adjustments, investigating exceptions, and publishing the valuations that P&L, risk, exposure, and reconciliation run on.
pipeline_rationale: output dependency: structured-deal capture consumes valuation outputs; not a prerequisite gate
reviewer_notes: FLAG: proposed REMAP to dependsOnOutputOf is a verb change at emission time — the same case as REL-00445. Whether capturing structured deals consumes valuations as an output or needs them as a prerequisite is a source-meaning question. Recommend HOLD for workbook correction per the source-meaning rule, not the remap.
Hamid_rationale: The asserted requires relation is not sufficiently supported as a prerequisite gate, and the proposed remap to core:dependsOnOutputOf would alter source meaning at emission time. Emit no triple. Route for source-workbook relationship review and correction. Hamid 2026-09-25.

source_definition: Coordinate the confirmation-side processing of agreed post-execution changes to a trade — including amendments, allocations, partial terminations, and early terminations — by validating counterparty agreement, initiating or validating the required controlled trade-record update, re-confirming revised terms, and triggering applicable lifecycle reporting.
target_definition: Perform the controlled pre-trade analysis, authorization, and post-execution recording of trades in the trading system — capturing complete commercial, operational, and regulatory terms by deal type and submitting required creation-data reports — so authorized transactions are available to confirmation, risk, actualization, settlement, and accounting processes.
pipeline_rationale: prerequisite condition: a captured trade must exist before it can be modified
reviewer_notes: Genuine prerequisite: a trade must be captured before post-execution modifications can be processed. Recommend approve KEEP core:requires.
Hamid_rationale: Clear lifecycle dependency: a post-execution amendment, allocation, or termination can only update a trade record that exists in controlled trade capture. Stored as core:requires. Hamid 2026-09-25.

source_definition: Coordinate prospective program-member/cardholder onboarding by capturing applications, validating completeness, and initiating required Credit, KYC, Compliance, Master Data, contract, and program-eligibility controls. Request establishment of governed customer, member, and card-account records through their owning master-data controls, and confirm activation readiness.
target_definition: Execute know-your-customer due diligence: verify customer identity and legal existence, collect, verify, and maintain beneficial-ownership information where required by applicable policy, law, regulation, customer type, or risk rating, screen customers and counterparties against sanctions and watchlists, assess KYC risk per the enterprise framework, and refresh due diligence on the required cycles and trigger events.
pipeline_rationale: prerequisite condition: KYC due diligence gates prospect setup (stable-ID target)
reviewer_notes: Genuine prerequisite gate: KYC due diligence must complete before prospect onboarding. Recommend approve KEEP core:requires.
Hamid_rationale: Legitimate onboarding gate: KYC due diligence is initiated before governed customer/member/card-account records are established. Stored as core:requires. Hamid 2026-09-25.

source_definition: Coordinate prospective program-member/cardholder onboarding by capturing applications, validating completeness, and initiating required Credit, KYC, Compliance, Master Data, contract, and program-eligibility controls. Request establishment of governed customer, member, and card-account records through their owning master-data controls, and confirm activation readiness.
target_definition: Decide customer-level credit: assess creditworthiness from KYC outcomes, financial statements, bureau data, payment history, parent support and credit-support instruments, and industry, geography, product, and channel risk; establish credit limits, risk codes, terms eligibility, and required security (guarantees, letters of credit, prepayment, deposits) per policy and the delegations of authority; and record decisions to governed master data with effective dates and review schedules.
pipeline_rationale: prerequisite condition: credit limit & risk code gate prospect setup
reviewer_notes: Genuine prerequisite gate: credit limit/risk code must be established before prospect setup. Recommend approve KEEP core:requires.
Hamid_rationale: Superseded 2026-09-26 (identity-rule scope ruling): target identity rests on exact-unique-current label match only; no rule 5 route — no explicit citation (partial "Credit" mention does not count), no strict inverse two-way mention, no same-branch structural nearness. Prior approval text kept in provenance: Approved despite B:structural-nearness context: source definition names Credit controls among mandatory onboarding controls; target establishes the limit, risk code, terms eligibility, and security conditions. SCOPE NOTE: credit-controlled onboarding prerequisite only — not every prospect/card-account setup requires a non-zero limit or full facility; the required credit/risk decision must be established under the applicable onboarding policy. Stored as core:requires. Hamid 2026-09-25.
